name: Taqueria El Sol De Mexico
tagline: Breakfast tacos to dinner plates on East Villa Maria, 8 AM to 10 PM daily.
about: Taqueria El Sol De Mexico serves homestyle Mexican food from Suite 100 of the Tejas Center on East Villa Maria Road.
It's open every day from 8 AM to 10 PM. In reviews, people mention the enchiladas, fajitas and tripas tacos.
